name: deploy-offline-update-rollback
prompt: Design an offline-capable installer and updater for a production WPF application with digital signature verification, atomic replacement, database migration compatibility, and automatic rollback.
rubric: Keeps update replacement logic outside the running main executable.
Defines signature verification, staging, health checks, rollback, and database forward/backward compatibility.
Includes install, upgrade, repair, uninstall, failed-update, and power-loss validation.
